** **
 The Police Inspector of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 3 for the offences punishable U/s. U/s.498A, 323, 506 of IPC.& Sec. 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Suchitra.
The gist of the prosecution case is that complainant got married accused No.1 on 18.11.2018.
At the time of marriage, as per the demand of the accused persons, the parents of the complainant had given golden ornaments to the accused No.1 and the complainant.
After the marriage, when the complainant was residing with the accused persons, accused No.1 to 3 used to quarrel with complainant for petty matters.
Accused No.1 and 2 used to force complainant to bring dowry from her house and were ill-treating her.
On  3  C.C.No.27737/2022 8.10.2021, accused No.1 came home drunk and assaulted complainant and caused injury.
Accused No.2 abused complainant in foul and filthy language and told her to die and thereby accused No.1 to 3 caused physical and mental cruelty to the complainant.
Based on the information of Smt.Suchitra, a case in Cr.No.226/2021 came to be registered against the accused No.1 to 3 for the aforesaid offences .

On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused No.1 to 3 entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.1 to 3 and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused No.1 to 3 in the language known to them, to which, the accused No.1 to 3 pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The  4  C.C.No.27737/2022 plea of the accused No.1 to 3 was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 & P.2 documents
As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused No.1 to 3, the recording of Statement of Accused No.1 to 3 as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused No.1 to 3 caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and and assaulted her and threatened her to do away  with her life and thereby accused No.1 to 3 have Suchitra W/O Manjunath vs Manjunath on 12 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82529291/
3  committed the offences punishable 498(A), 323, 506  R/W 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act?
 2) what order?

8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.

As per final order, for the following:
 R E A SON S  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond  5  C.C.No.27737/2022 reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 to 3, the prosecution has examined complainant Smt.
Suchitra as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement and Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.

10. PW-1 in her examination-in-chief deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 18-11-2018 and after the marriage, accused persons looked after her well and deposed accused persons did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and accused persons did not assault her and threatened her with dire consequences.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused persons in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station, there the police have took her signature on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.

PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her Suchitra W/O Manjunath vs Manjunath on 12 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82529291/

sentences.text: The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused persons have compromised  6  C.C.No.27737/2022 the matter and denied all other suggestions.
Though PW-1 was cross examined by the prosecution, nothing worth could be elicited.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under are acquitted for the offences punishable C.C.No.27737/2022 U/s.498A, 323, 506 of IPC.& Sec. 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bond of accused No.1 to 3 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
